**Givens:** Q = 1.5 L/s, D = 40 mm, L = 35 m, static lift 6 m. Water at 20 °C (ρ = 998 kg/m³, ν = 1.004 × 10⁻⁶ m²/s). Commercial steel pipe, roughness ε = 0.045 mm.

1. Velocity: V = Q/A = 0.0015 / (π × 0.04²/4) = 1.19 m/s
2. Reynolds: Re = VD/ν = 4.76 × 10⁴ (turbulent)
3. Relative roughness ε/D = 0.045/40 = 0.0011
4. Colebrook gives f = 0.0236
5. Friction loss h_f = f (L/D) V²/2g = 1.49 m
6. Minor losses (entrance, 2 elbows, valve): ΣK = 2.5 → 0.18 m

Total head ≈ 7.7 m. Add a 20% margin: about 9.2 m at 1.5 L/s (5.4 m³/h).

**Pump:** a small centrifugal pump on 230 V mains, e.g. one rated 10 m head at 6 m³/h. Hydraulic power ≈ 113 W, so a 0.37 kW motor is plenty. A safety factor of 1.2 on head is included.
